name: TeamStarWolf - Threat Group: Volt Typhoon (G1017)
description: ATT&CK-documented techniques attributed to Volt Typhoon (G1017; aliases: BRONZE SILHOUETTE, Vanguard Panda, DEV-0391, UNC3236, Voltzite, Insidious Taurus). Sourced directly from MITRE's intrusion-set to technique 'uses' relationships in the bundled ATT&CK v16 data - this is MITRE's own attribution, not a curated TeamStarWolf mapping. Every row is documented group use (score 100). Absence of a technique does not mean the group cannot use it; it means MITRE has not documented it.
